ideas.idea: Make the Dentist JSON-LD more complete (address, url, hours, geo, logo, sameAs)
ideas.why: The schema has only name and telephone while the address and details are visible on the page, so adding them helps machines understand the business.

ideas.idea: Add named clinician profiles with credentials and specialties on /team
ideas.why: The team page has no names or qualifications, so concrete profiles give people and machines something real to read.

ideas.idea: Add a fallback or require descriptions in the template
ideas.why: This restates the known empty /team description problem as a template-level safeguard.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card tags
ideas.why: This is accurate because none exist, but it applies to almost any site and mainly affects social previews.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the insurance terms
ideas.why: It reverses a deliberate choice that the brief says is fine.

ideas.idea: Replace 'trusted by thousands' and 'decades of experience' with verifiable evidence
ideas.why: Both claims really appear on the pages as unsupported statements, and specific evidence is more credible to readers and AI systems.

ideas.idea: Expand thin content with treatment details, pricing, hours, emergency process and dedicated treatment pages
ideas.why: The services page is just a four-item list that says prices are 'simple and clear' without giving any, so concrete detail would help.
Recommending FAQs as a standard addition is folklore and not tied to anything missing from this site.

ideas.idea: Wire geo.config.json origin and policy into the build, or remove it
ideas.why: The config is not used by the Eleventy build, and using its origin for canonicals would fix the hardcoded host.

ideas.idea: Make the robots.txt AI crawler policy explicit
ideas.why: Allow: / already permits all crawlers, including AI ones, which matches the configured policy, so explicit rules add little.
